title: SDV Pipeline — Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A bank-grade synthetic data generation pipeline that profiles CSV data, uses an LLM (AWS Bedrock Claude) to translate business rules into structured constraints, and enforces them through a multi-stage post-processing layer to produce privacy-preserving synthetic financial datasets. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, Metadata detection, and CAG/legacy constraint classes as the core synthesis engine.
